# Volleyball Stats

UI catalog: `docs/UI_COMPONENTS.md`.

Same discovery shell as basketball: Etusivu, Selaa, Haku, Suosikit. No hardcoded match.

Extra, because volleyball records them: set start and end clocks, six-shirt rotations per set, and a wall-clock time on every `piste` event. Do not invent any of the three when TASO omitted them.

Live: https://volleyball-stats-7xq.pages.dev
Proxy referer: `https://tulospalvelu.lentopallo.fi/`
